caption: The drawing depicts a single pair of trousers positioned upright in the center of the image against a plain, light beige background. The trousers are rendered in shades of brown and tan, with subtle variations in tone to indicate folds, shadows, and creases. The pants feature a waistband with a single button at the top center, belt loops spaced evenly along the waistband, and a fly at the front. There is a visible pocket on the left side from the viewer’s perspective, with stitching outlined. The legs of the trousers are straight and slightly tapered towards the bottom, with gentle contour lines suggesting fabric texture and depth. The drawing is signed "W.O. Fletcher" in the lower right corner.
title: Trousers
